description: Header file defining the CallService class for managing call-related functionalities in a modem simulator, including handling calls, call states, and dependencies on other services.

classes.name: CallService
classes.description: A class that manages call operations such as dialing, accepting, rejecting, and hanging up calls within a modem simulation environment.

classes.name: CallStatus
classes.description: A nested struct within CallService representing the status and state of an individual call, including call state, number, and various flags.

methods.name: CallService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CallService with service ID, channel monitor, and thread looper.

methods.name: ~CallService
methods.description: Default destructor.

methods.name: SetupDependency
methods.description: Sets up dependencies on SimService and NetworkService.

methods.name: HandleDial
methods.description: Handles dialing a call from a client with a specified command.

methods.name: HandleAcceptCall
methods.description: Handles accepting an incoming call from a client.

methods.name: HandleRejectCall
methods.description: Handles rejecting an incoming call from a client.

methods.name: HandleCurrentCalls
methods.description: Handles request to list current calls.

methods.name: HandleHangup
methods.description: Handles hanging up a call.

methods.name: HandleMute
methods.description: Handles muting a call.

methods.name: HandleSendDtmf
methods.description: Handles sending DTMF tones during a call.

methods.name: HandleCancelUssd
methods.description: Handles canceling USSD sessions.

methods.name: HandleEmergencyMode
methods.description: Handles toggling emergency mode.

methods.name: HandleRemoteCall
methods.description: Handles remote call operations.

methods.name: FindFreeCallIndex
methods.description: Finds the next available index for a new call.

methods.name: InitializeServiceState
methods.description: Initializes the service state.

methods.name: InitializeCommandHandlers
methods.description: Initializes command handlers.

methods.name: SimulatePendingCallsAnswered
methods.description: Simulates answering pending calls.

methods.name: CallStateUpdate
methods.description: Updates the state of calls.

methods.name: SendCallStatusToRemote
methods.description: Sends call status updates to remote clients.

methods.name: TimerWaitingRemoteCallResponse
methods.description: Sets a timer for waiting remote call response.
